intro: If you want to stay in Amnat Charoen away from the noise of the town-centre streets, in a big, clean, quiet room that's easy on the wallet, Baan Ing Daan in the Ban Non Nam Thaeng area of Bung is the place guests keep mentioning. Rooms start at around THB 520/night and it scores 8.5 from 6 reviews — high for this price bracket.

body.html: Baan Ing Daan sits at 791 Moo 16, Bung Subdistrict, Mueang Amnat Charoen, in the Ban Non Nam Thaeng area — an edge-of-town location that stays nicely quiet, set back from the busy town-centre streets but still a short drive from the centre and big-box shopping like Makro and Big C. What guests mention most is the calm and the garden setting around the property, a charm you don't often get from a stay in the middle of town.

It's a small guesthouse with only a handful of rooms (around 20), and the standout is that the rooms are spacious and kept very clean. Reviews give cleanliness a notably high score, and several guests note the rooms are bigger than you'd expect at this price. Every room has air conditioning, a TV, an en-suite bathroom and free Wi-Fi, with a fridge and kettle in some rooms. The look is simple and easy on the eye rather than fancy, but it's functional and well cared for — a good fit for travellers who value a clean, comfortable bed over decor.
"Big room, super clean, incredibly quiet with no noise at all, good service, and there's even a roof over the parking — great value."

What lifts a small place like this to an 8.5 is that guests agree on the cleanliness and the quiet. One short review simply says "10 out of 10" for the good service and the genuinely silent location. A couple of other points add to the score: the parking is generous and has a roof to shade the cars, which self-drivers love, and the 24-hour front desk is flexible for late arrivals. For anyone coming to Amnat Charoen on business or just passing through who wants a good, quiet, safe room, these are exactly the things that matter.

To be honest — this is a small edge-of-town guesthouse, not a full-facility resort. There's no pool and no breakfast, and because it's outside the town centre in a garden area, you really need your own car to head out to eat or sightsee. The rooms are limited and reviews say it's often full, so book or call ahead. Water pressure draws mixed comments — some guests say it flows strong, one or two found it a little slow, so set expectations accordingly. And with only around 6 online reviews so far and prices that move with the season, it's worth comparing rates before you book.

In short, Baan Ing Daan suits travellers who want a quiet garden stay in Amnat Charoen with a spacious, clean room, a light price, and their own car. Set your expectations right — a small, well-kept, genuinely quiet guesthouse, not a full-day resort with every amenity — and it delivers more than its price, and the 8.5 from 6 reviews confirms that most people who've stayed left happy.
